blocks.text:
Take a water taxi to Belize City.

In the morning, take a sightseeing tour of the city.

Belize City was founded in the second quarter of the 17th century by British pirates on the site of a small Maya town called Olzuz. Its location on the Caribbean coast near several river mouths helped it grow quickly.

Belize City suffered repeated natural disasters. The capital was moved to Belmopan, but Belize City remained the country’s largest city and an important port.

Sights include the performing arts centre, the Eco-Museum dedicated to Belize’s tropical environment, the former residence of the British governor and St John’s Anglican Cathedral. Built in 1812, the cathedral is one of the city’s oldest buildings.

After the tour, transfer to Belize International Airport for your flight home.
